description: This file contains the implementation of advanced QR code segment encoding logic, including functions for optimal segmentation, mode switching, and kanji encoding, within a QR code generator library.

classes.name: QrSegmentAdvanced
classes.description: Provides advanced QR code segmentation and encoding methods, including optimal segmentation and kanji mode support.

methods.name: makeSegmentsOptimally
methods.description: Generates an optimally segmented list of QR code segments for a given Unicode string, considering version and error correction constraints.

methods.name: makeSegmentsOptimally (private)
methods.description: Internal method to compute the best segmentation for a given text and version.

methods.name: computeBitCosts
methods.description: Calculates the cost in bits for encoding segments in different modes, used for dynamic programming optimization.

methods.name: computeCharacterModes
methods.description: Determines the optimal mode for each character in the data, working backwards from the end.

methods.name: splitIntoSegments
methods.description: Splits the data into segments based on computed character modes.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a character can be encoded in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a character can be encoded in numeric mode.

methods.name: makeKanjiSegment
methods.description: Creates a QR code segment encoding a string in kanji mode, with validation.

methods.name: isEncodableAsKanji
methods.description: Tests if a string can be encoded entirely in kanji mode.
